title: Biggest Clear Lot
description:
## Task

A survey map of a construction site is a grid of cells, each either clear (`1`) or blocked (`0`). A builder wants the largest axis-aligned rectangular lot made entirely of clear cells. Return its area in cells.

## Input

- `site` — a list of equal-length strings of `0` and `1`, one string per row. It may be empty.

## Output

An integer: the area of the largest rectangle containing only `1` cells, or `0` if there is none.

## Example

```python
biggest_clear_lot(['10100', '10111', '11111', '10010'])  # returns 6
biggest_clear_lot(['00', '00'])  # returns 0
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ number of rows ≤ 400
- 0 ≤ row length ≤ 400 (all rows have the same length)
- Each character is `0` or `1`.
- Large grids appear in the tests; trying every rectangle will be too slow.
